fetch_recipe.verification: Read nonempty semantic body, record actual bytes and SHA256, cross-check fetch terminal and remote/local digest. Do not trust rc=0 or HEAD Content-Length=0 alone.
fetch_recipe.rate_measurement: Small pieces are below sampler resolution; reported 0.000 is NOT_MEASURED, not measured zero. Wget tiny buffered tails can exceed the set rate; peak-window total compliance is NOT_ESTABLISHED. Do not present c14_ok=1 as independent proof.
fetch_recipe.failure_policy: No blind retry; retain failed logs and remote shared caches. A changed candidate or isolated capture query is a new scoped attempt.
fetch_recipe.caveat: Historical captures used a tool with a zero-length HEAD/already-complete false intermediate gate. Their final failed pulls and missing bodies remain NOT_CAPTURED. Continuation pins the later read-only tool separately; no tool was modified here.
